### Measuring the Gap Between Human and LLM Research Ideas
**Source:** arXiv  
**Insight:** This study evaluates the disparity between ideas generated by large language models (LLMs) and those developed by human researchers. It finds that while LLMs can produce a variety of plausible research ideas, their outputs are more concentrated around specific types of opportunities (e.g., bridge-like connections) compared to the broader range of approaches used by humans.
